description.zh:
指定返回代理的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
description.en:
Specifies the number of agents to be returned.\
Valid values: 0 - 1000.\
Default value: 1000.

description.zh:
设定从该marker之后列举代理。  
默认值：无
description.en:
The marker after which the agents are listed.\
By default, this parameter is left empty.

descriptions.zh: - 列举代理，您必须有mgw:ListImportAgent权限。
descriptions.en: *   To query a list of agents, you must have the permission on mgw:ListImportAgent.
